name: maize-watch-monorepo
description: Maize-Watch IoT Agriculture Monitoring System - Full Stack

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend/web-src/web-public && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd frontend/web-src/web-admin && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend/web-src/web-public && npm install && cd ../web-admin && npm install
scripts.postbuild: npm run copy:frontend && npm run copy:admin
scripts.copy:frontend: cp -r frontend/web-src/web-public/dist/* backend/dist/ || xcopy /E /I frontend\web-src\web-public\dist\* backend\dist\
scripts.copy:admin: mkdir -p backend/dist/web-admin && cp -r frontend/web-src/web-admin/dist/* backend/dist/web-admin/ || (mkdir backend\dist\web-admin 2>nul & xcopy /E /I frontend\web-src\web-admin\dist\* backend\dist\web-admin\)
